hb.title: HC Budget Setting
hb.description: Maintain machine and activity head count budgets, visibility, and display order
hb.help.title: HC Budget Setting — User guide
hb.ui.pick_process: Choose the process whose HC budget you want to maintain.
hb.ui.no_permission_text: You are not allowed to work on any HC process. Ask the HeadCount group admin for access.
hb.ui.hint_standard: Edit Machine, Type, Category, or Budget HC inline, then press Confirm to save all changes together.
hb.ui.hint_admin: Edit inline, add or hide rows, or drag handles to adjust per-process display order. Press Confirm to save all changes together.
hb.ui.hint_reorder_disabled: Clear the filter box to drag or move rows and adjust display order.
hb.ui.empty_rows: No machines or activities found for this process.
hb.ui.empty_filter: No rows match the current filter.
hb.ui.err_station_required: Station code must be an integer between 1 and 32767.
hb.ui.err_station_dup: Station code {code} is already used in {process}.
hb.ui.err_cost_center_len: Cost center can be at most 4 characters.
hb.ui.err_process_code: Process code must be a whole number (-32768 to 32767).
hb.ui.err_fix_before_save: Fix the highlighted validation error(s) before confirming.
hb.ui.add_category_placeholder: Optional — pick existing or type new
hb.ui.discard_text: All unsaved edits, staged additions, hidden toggles, and sequence changes will be reverted.
hb.ui.leave_text: You have unsaved changes for {process}. Discard them and switch process?
hb.tour.picker.title: Choose a process
hb.tour.picker.text: Only processes your account is permitted to manage are shown. Your selection is shared with HC Scan Assign during this browser session.
hb.tour.controls.title: Filter and tools
hb.tour.controls.text: Filter rows by machine, category, station code, or type. Administrators also see Show hidden and Add Machine / Activity here.
hb.tour.add.title: Add machine or activity
hb.tour.add.text: Administrators can add a new machine or activity here. Station code is required and unique per process; new rows are staged until you press Confirm.
hb.tour.counters.title: Live budget summary
hb.tour.counters.text: Tracks active rows, hidden rows, total active Budget HC, and how many unsaved changes are pending.
hb.tour.actions.title: Discard and Confirm
hb.tour.actions.text: All edits stay local until you press Confirm, which writes every change in one database transaction. Use Discard to revert unsaved edits.
hb.tour.table.title: Editable budget table
hb.tour.table.text: Edit Machine, Type, Category (with existing suggestions), and Budget HC directly in the table. Modified rows are highlighted.
hb.tour.reorder.title: Display sequence (Admin)
hb.tour.reorder.text: Administrators can drag rows by the handle or click the arrow buttons to set each process's display order (1..N) used across HC pages.
hb.msg.log_warning: Saved to the database, but MQPDHeadCount.log could not be updated. Python Dash pages may take longer to refresh their cache.
hb.err.permission_check_failed: Your permission could not be verified right now. Try again in a moment.
hb.err.no_process_permission: You don't have permission to manage {process} HC budget.
hb.err.forbidden_admin: Only administrators can add machines, change hidden status, or reorder display sequence.
hb.err.bad_request: The request payload is not valid.
hb.err.invalid_machine: Machine / activity name must be non-empty (max 120 characters).
hb.err.invalid_station_code: Station code for "{machine}" must be an integer between 1 and 32767.
hb.err.duplicate_station_code: Station code {code} already exists in {process} (including hidden rows).
hb.err.invalid_type: Type for "{machine}" must be Routine or Non-routine.
hb.err.invalid_cost_center: Cost center for "{machine}" must be at most 4 characters.
hb.err.invalid_process_code: Process code for "{machine}" is out of range for smallint.
hb.err.invalid_category: Category for "{machine}" must be at most 80 characters.
hb.err.invalid_budget: Budget HC for "{machine}" must be a non-negative number (up to 8 integer and 12 decimal digits).
hb.err.unknown_row: Row "{id}" was not found in this process. Reload and try again.
hb.err.too_many_rows: Too many rows to assign a smallint display sequence.
hb.err.nothing_to_save: There are no changes to save.
hb.err.save_failed: Saving to the database failed. Nothing was written. Please contact an administrator.
